title: wg: draft-mahy-mimi-msgid-aad-03 gaps (item encoding, verification, negotiation)
description:
From assay mimid-1wgh.44.7 of /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-mimi-msgid-aad-03.txt. Posting needs Mark's OK (github.com/rohanmahy/mimi-msgid-aad).

1. Encoding: L132-134 says the item 'MUST contain the MIMI content Message ID' but not the aad_item_data bytes; say it is the 32-octet Message ID of content-10 §3.3 as is (no further framing).
2. Verification: a provider cannot check the value against the encrypted content, and the text never asks members to. A sender can put a different ID in the AAD than the content gives, misleading provider logs or abuse handling. Say members SHOULD (or MAY) compute the ID and compare, and what a mismatch means; say providers MUST NOT rely on it for anything but diagnostics. §4 (L143-147) covers only the privacy side.
3. Negotiation: no rule on when a client may add the item. Under mls-extensions-11 §5 a component that uses Safe AAD is listed in app_components and safe_aad; say whether the item is sent only when the GroupContext safe_aad lists message_id.
4. L138 calls it 'this extension'; it is a component.
5. References: content-09 (L175-180) and mls-extensions-10 (L182-187) are now -10 and -11; the cited sections (content §3.3, extensions §4.9) are unchanged.
